title: YouTube releases new AI features for creators within its Studio app
slides: YouTube's new Studio AI: friend or replacement?
It offers tools like automatic video editing and thumbnails.
But creators worry about losing their unique creative touch.
You can start using these tools to save hours per video.
Experiment now to stay ahead of the curve.
thread_text:
1. AI Takes Over Editing

YouTube's new Studio AI can automatically edit your videos and generate thumbnails. But what does that mean for your creative control?

2. The Promise of Speed

These tools promise to save you hours per video, letting you focus on bigger things. But at what cost?

3. The Creative Dilemma

Creators fear losing their unique touch as AI homogenizes content. Will your style get lost in the automation?

4. The Risk of Sameness

If everyone uses the same AI tools, won't all videos start to look and feel the same? That's the worry.

5. Your Move: Test It Now

Try one AI tool on your next video. If you save time but lose your voice, is it worth it? Share your experience.

You can now get your videos cut and your thumbnails made automatically inside the YouTube Studio app. 🎬
